messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Thompson <avery@stratus.ai>, Gina Moreno <gina.moreno@stratus.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Stratus — Post-call: Proof Statement & evaluation playbook

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clarity on the two primary use cases (summarization pipeline and live assistant). As promised, here’s a concise post-call recap, the proposed "Proof Statement" (the single sentence we need to prove in the POC), and the playbook we recommend for the 3-week evaluation.

Proof Statement:
- By the end of the 3-week trial, Redwood can serve Stratus’ live assistant workload with <= 250ms p95 latency at 150 concurrent sessions (avg length 120 tokens) while keeping inference cost <= $0.0009 / token for the production prompt distribution and maintaining an automated quality pass rate >= 90% on the acceptance prompt set.

Primary KPIs (to be used as gating criteria):
- Latency: p50/p95 targets: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 250ms (measured end-to-end from assistant API call to first token and full response).
- Throughput: sustained 150 concurrent sessions (estimated ~20 req/s overall with bursts up to 60 req/s).
- Cost: target inference cost <= $0.0009 per token (we will show cost breakdown and batch sizing).
- Quality: automated check should pass >= 90% of your acceptance prompts (we’ll run both automated metrics + 50 manual evals).
- Stability: zero critical errors, <0.5% 5xx rate during test windows.

Evaluation plan (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (this week): Data exchange + infra prep. You provide 2K sample sessions (anonymized) and the acceptance prompt set. Redwood provides trial env spec and onboarding window; sign off on mutual action plan.
- Week 1: Baseline runs on our hosted sandbox using your prompts — measure baseline latency, cost, and quality. Quick wins: quantization + batching config.
- Week 2: Iteration — enable KV caching + prefix caching and test canary at 50 sessions; tune batch sizing and sequence length cutoff. Begin manual quality evals.
- Week 3: Production-like run at 150 concurrent sessions for 2 hours to validate p95 & cost targets, run final acceptance checks and produce a short playbook for production rollout (recommended config and cost projection).

Owners / Asks (who does what):
- Stratus: deliver anonymized sample sessions + acceptance prompt set by Thu 2027-04-08 (Avery).
- Redwood (Ben): provision trial namespace and share credentials by Fri 2027-04-09; run baseline experiments and share initial report by Mon 2027-04-12.
- Redwood (Jordan): test harness + perf scripts; Karthik to own quantization profiles and cost calc.
- Legal/Procurement: Gina to share contract checklist and any minimum SSO/KMS requirements.

Attachments: I attached a short sample profile CSV (stratus_sample_profile.csv) with anonymized session schema, plus the draft Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and the trial environment spec (trial_env_spec.yaml).

Next steps (concrete):
1) Avery to confirm timeline for data handoff (target Thu 4/8).
2) Gina to confirm procurement timing / any terms that could block dedicated trial capacity.
3) Redwood to schedule 90-minute kickoff demo + environment walkthrough (suggest Thu 4/9 11am PT).

Thanks — I’ll be on standby to get the trial bootstrapped as soon as we have the sample data.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

2) Quality pass rate: the 90% automated pass — can you describe the automated checks you’ll run (syntactic checks, hallucination detector, intent match)?
3) Data handoff: we can deliver 2K anonymized sessions by Thu 4/8. We’ll redact any PII and provide a small mapping doc for session types.

We’re comfortable with the timeline; the only likely blocker is procurement — Gina can follow up on that. Also, can you add an explicit success criterion for token truncation behavior (e.g., how the assistant truncates long turns) so our ML team can validate correctness?

Happy to jump on the kickoff Thu 4/9 11am PT — that works for me.
